transcription: Main article text only (site header and menus, breadcrumb, Bookmark/Share widget, sidebar and footer removed). Each dated step heading kept as its own line exactly as printed (e.g. 'November 5, 2024—Election Day'), followed by its parenthetical rule line and description paragraphs. The force-majeure footnote about modified voting periods kept as printed with its asterisk. Curly quotes and em dashes kept. Whitespace normalised.
purpose: library: the 2024–2025 Electoral College calendar as a dated chronology — Election Day November 5, 2024; Certificates of Ascertainment by December 11, 2024 (at least six days before the electors meet); electors vote December 17, 2024; electoral votes arrive by December 25, 2024; the Archivist transfers Certificates on or before January 3, 2025; Congress counts the votes January 6, 2025 (objections need one-fifth of each chamber; only two grounds allowed); inauguration January 20, 2025 at noon — plus the contingent-election rules (no 270 majority: the House chooses the President among the top three candidates, one vote per State; the Senate chooses the Vice President among the top two). Ideal for timeline/date ordering and quiz cards with predict-then-reveal on the dates and rules.
